Table 3.2: Census counts by Indigenous status, Tasmania, Local Government Areas, 2016
Data is based on place of usual residence. Excludes overseas visitors.
(a) Local Government Areas (LGAs) are an ABS approximation of officially gazetted LGAs as defined by each State and Territory Local Government Department. LGAs cover incorporated areas of Australia.

Where an incorporated area has an official status, it is assigned an LGA status type: Cities (C) Areas (A) Rural Cities (RC), Boroughs (B) Shires (S) Towns (T) Regional Councils (R) Municipalities/Municipal Councils (M),
District Councils (DC), SA Regional Councils (RegC) Aboriginal Councils (AC).
For further information, see the Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3.

(b) This table provides 2016 Census data on 2021 LGA boundaries to allow for direct comparisons between the 2011 and 2021 Census. As a result, the 2016 Census data in this table will differ to previously published 2011 Census data.
(c) Includes Migratory-Offshore-Shipping and No Usual Address.

Please note that there are small random adjustments made to all cell values to protect the confidentiality of data. These adjustments may cause the sum of rows or columns to differ by small amounts from table totals.
